assets.title: Authored Rocky Mountain lodgepole archetypes
assets.geometry_provenance: Seeded connected branch graphs with staggered upward shoots and a tapered leader; whole lateral-shoot and primary-branch aggregates preserve middle-distance foliage coverage; four graph variants and four-direction far impostors.
assets.dimension_provenance: LiDAR-derived height and conservative core-equivalent radius remain source fields; TreeMap DBH/CR remain transferred. Full display width uses bounded Bechtold transfer or authored nonmetric photo proportions, with unknown local error.
assets.code_assistance: Procedural authoring code produced with assistant support.

sources.supports: clear slender bole and short upper crown in dense stands; paired needles 1-3 inches
tall straight narrow crowns in dense stands, broader open-site crowns; two-needle fascicles

limitations: Archetype dimensions are authored rendering assumptions, not measured allometry.
LiDAR-derived heights remain independent; full display crowns combine retained core radii with transferred or authored envelopes.
Fallback DBH is authored; TreeMap DBH/crown ratio are transferred. Display crown base adds an authored photo-derived constraint.
Needle cards approximate shoots; middle LODs aggregate attached shoots into bounded foliage envelopes while reducing wood tessellation.
Operator-supplied Tripo candidate is inspected separately and its unspecified license is not relabeled.
Far impostors retain the selected archetype crown ratio beyond 180 m.
Botanical acceptance and empirical allometry are not established by topology or rendering checks.
assets.credit: Authored lodgepole geometry and needle texture; CC0 bark by Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven.
notes: Crown density and apical taper are authored display parameters; source height, DBH, measured core radius and tree counts remain independent.
The terminal leader remains attached to the stem and the crown remains within its declared height.
More closely spaced upward branches balance two to three shoots per lateral; exactly collinear secondary tube rings are omitted without changing source graphs or curved axes.
assets.near_variation_scope: Each variant retains its seeded source graph through LOD0/1/2; far uses variant-specific four-direction impostors with retained envelope traits

display_envelope_model.coefficient_units: LCW in ft; DBH in inches
display_envelope_model.output_scope: Mean widest and perpendicular horizontal crown diameters of stand-grown trees

photo_display.limitations: Occluded bases, perspective and overlapping crowns prevent metric width estimates

references.supports: Small retained lower branches, straight boles and layered needle sprays; perspective width unmeasured
Overlapping lower foreground foliage; individual full crown boundaries unresolved

cutout_mipmaps.method: Linear-light premultiplied RGB; quantized alpha calibrated against bilinear and adjacent trilinear coverage
cutout_mipmaps.actual_screen_coverage: source-bound GPU capture report in evidence/tree-lod-quality.json; failures remain unaccepted
cutout_mipmaps.coarsest_level_policy: Nonempty one-texel mip remains conservatively opaque; fractional coverage is unrepresentable with a single fixed-cutoff sample
cutout_mipmaps.filter_validation: Independent held-out SciPy sampler in tools/tests/test_lodgepole_assets.py; actual projected geometry remains a separate native gate

assets.title: Residual compact needle shoots and far skin
assets.input_data: USGS LiDAR and matched DEM; source provenance retained in canopy metadata
assets.representation: Metric compact crossed shoot cards in anonymous source-grounded near/middle volumes, coarse far tapered proxy, and far continuous skin
limitations: Surface height uses an authored coverage-weighted 5 m neighbor average of source 2 m residual means.
Display smoothing error is unknown; raw heights and exact 0.5 m support remain unchanged.
Layer thickness and distance transitions are authored display parameters.
Source-mask conservation and texture-mip occupancy do not establish whole-scene visible canopy or photographic acceptance.
The residual surface adds no tree or stem count.
Residual source cells carry no branch skeleton or stem parent; their vertical volume is an explicitly authored display rule with unknown local crown-base error.
Coarse-proxy upper width0.22 of cell radius, seeded yaw, live interval0.70 of source top-minus-ground, no near disappearance, far skin transition180..260m.
Near/middle volume cards are anonymous residual foliage, not linked to observed stems or branch parents; individual edge sprays may read detached.
Far crossed proxy retains visible stippling; no photometric or reference realism acceptance claimed.
Unique source cell count159157 is independent of its three disjoint display LOD instance slots.
assets.stand_opacity: Observed support mask controls far skin opacity; needle texture affects far color only.
assets.cluster_opacity: Native source mask clips every LOD; near/middle cards use local authored needle UVs, coarse proxy uses0.40m world repeat; projected coverage remains unknown.
assets.cluster_normal_transform: Yaw and vertical scale; compact-card normals are horizontal and normalized. Shared culling bounds contain the full source-grounded interval.
assets.cluster_representation: Each active source cell uses disjoint display LODs:64/16compact0.40m crossed shoot clusters then three coarse planes. Source XY/top/support and unique cell count are unchanged; no stems added.
assets.near_visibility: No near disappearance; cutout foliage remains visible within the exact source support mask.
assets.shoot_physical_size_rule: Shader removes instance depth scale from card offsets; center margins retain complete cards within source interval. Depths below0.40m use an explicitly smaller fitted card.
assets.compact_radial_profile: Authored staggered shoot centers use0.28+0.72*depth_fraction times cell radius with golden-angle azimuth; source-cell yaw varies deterministically.

assets.credit: Original project display profile and procedural terrace relief; mapped runoff support from USGS / USDA NAIP public-domain orthoimagery.

source_assets.use: Geographically mapped orange-chroma support for runoff; not ground reflectance.

color_reference.basis: User-supplied hexadecimal color observations; image transects analyzed locally.
color_reference.reference_processing: Unknown camera response, illumination, tone mapping and steam path length.

assets.profile_position_class: Authored normalized polygon radius and shoreline distance; not measured ring widths.
assets.terrace_geometry_class: Authored band-limited normal and shading detail; no displaced survey geometry or bathymetry.
notes: Scientific radiative-transfer and microbial pigment outputs remain unchanged and independently available.
Colors are display targets under unknown photographic processing, not measured reflectance or ecological predictions.
Terrace spacing, relief and ring widths are authored assumptions with unknown local uncertainty.
Google Maps screenshot pixels are not bundled or used as copied texture content.

files.processing: Unchanged level0 RGBA8; premultiplied linear-sRGB box-filtered mip levels, encoded to sRGB RGB and linear alpha.

assets.title: Forest Ground 03 pine-needle litter
assets.human_source_evidence: Named photographer Rob Tuytel; original Poly Haven material. Source API identifies pine needles, fallen leaf litter and twigs.
assets.credit: Forest Ground 03 by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven (CC0).
notes: Human photographed generic pine-needle litter; local Yellowstone species and cover are not inferred.
Original 1k JPEG files retained unchanged. Forest terrain layer and shallow litter beds use the source 2 m width.
Old Forest Ground 04 remains available for meadow and mineral substrate. Metallic remains disabled.

files.processing: Unchanged level0 RGBA8; premultiplied linear-sRGB box-filtered mip levels, encoded to sRGB RGB and linear alpha.

assets.title: Grounded representative pine bough display
assets.human_source_evidence: Original CC0 pine-tree twig photograph and alpha atlas; unchanged visible RGB in the source shoot crop.
assets.credit: Pine Tree 01 by Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven (CC0); source-preserving crop and authored display assembly.
notes: Five unchanged 0.18 by 0.36 m authored shoot images form a connected 0.48 by 0.64 m authored bough.
All dimensions and branching are illustrative, with unknown local uncertainty; no local species or stem-count inference.
The source manifest records exact crop, affine assembly and coverage-preserving mip procedure.

assets.title: Terrain linear-light mip provenance
notes: Eight original color inputs retain their own asset licenses and provenance; their derived buffers are listed in the corresponding source asset records.
Filtering occurs offline in premultiplied linear sRGB. Normal, ARM, mask and scientific pigment inputs are excluded.
Total derived buffer storage is 111848096 bytes; existing GPU RGBA8 mip allocations and sampler counts are retained.
